<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

A single-page application of the app's (an admin panel, a customer portal), in React, used by name: blueprint spa admin. It lives in web/&lt;name>, in the workspace, with the API's TypeScript client, sign-in by the session cookie of a realm (with the page asked for kept for after it), a responsive layout, a light and dark theme, and resources: each entity marked @&lt;name>(resource) gets its list (the API's filters, sorting, search and pages, in the URL), its form (by field type, with the API's errors on their fields) and its page. What is generated is regenerated; what is yours (src/resources, src/pages, src/components, src/menu.ts, src/messages.ts, src/theme.css) is written once and left alone. With serve app, the app's binary serves it, on its domain (or under its path).

```esquadro
blueprint spa
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [http](../http/), [rest](../rest/), [client_ts](../client_ts/), [workspace](../workspace/), [security](../security/): the app must use them too.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `domain` | string | `""` | The domain it answers on (admin.shop.com); without one, the app's domain, under path. |
| `path` | string | `""` | Its path on the app's domain, when it has no domain of its own; /&lt;name> by default. |
| `auth` | string | `""` | The realm that signs in to it; the first realm by default. |
| `roles` | list | `[]` | The roles of the realm let in; any role when empty. |
| `locale` | name | `"en"` | en or pt_br: the language of its own words (src/messages.ts) and of dates, numbers and money. |
| `serve` | name | `"app"` | app: the app's binary serves it, built in. (image, a container of its own, is planned.) |
| `sidebar` | name | `"icon"` | The sidebar, from shadcn/ui's blocks: icon (sidebar-07, it collapses to its icons), inset (sidebar-08, the page in an inset card) or dashboard (dashboard-01, it slides away, wider). |
| `idle_minutes` | int | `0` | Minutes without use after which the frontend signs out (a warning comes a minute before); 0, never. |

```esquadro
blueprint spa {
  domain ""
}
```

## Annotations

| Where | Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| entity | `resource` | bool | The entity is a resource of the frontend: its list, form and page. |
| entity | `label` | string | What people call it, in the frontend's language: Offers. |
| entity | `singular` | string | What one of it is called, in titles: "Product". |
| entity | `menu` | string | Its entry in the menu; the label by default. |
| entity | `group` | string | The section of the menu it is in, with the other resources of the same group: "Catalog". |
| entity | `icon` | name | The icon of its menu entry, a Lucide name: tag, users, shopping_cart. |
| field | `label` | string | What people call the field, in the frontend's language: Price. |
| relation | `label` | string | What people call the relation, in the frontend's language: Category. |
| value | `label` | string | What people call a value of an enum, in the frontend's language: Active. |

An annotation is written `@spa(key value)` on the element.
